identity.title: MeerKAT observations of starburst galaxies and AGNs within the core of XMMXCS J2215.9-1738 at z = 1.46
identity.journal: Monthly Notices of the Royal Astronomical Society

evidence.quote: We classified 12/24 ($50\%$) as galaxies whose radio emission is dominated by star-formation activity
